# Unique trigger word/prefix in WhatsApp chats (case-insensitive, default: @weave)
BOT_TRIGGER=@weave

# Default website/project directory to modify when none is specified
DEFAULT_PROJECT_DIR=./demo-site

# Antigravity CLI binary & optional model override
AGY_BIN=agy
# Leave empty to use your default Antigravity model, or set e.g. gemini-3.8-flash-high
AGY_MODEL=

# Security: Comma-separated phone numbers allowed to run tasks (e.g. 919876543210,14155552671)
# Set to * to allow anyone in the group who uses the BOT_TRIGGER prefix
ALLOWED_SENDERS=*

# Owner/admin phone numbers (digits only, comma-separated). Messages from these
# numbers are treated as the bot owner even from a different device.
# ADMIN_NUMBERS=919876543210

# Allow triggering the bot from the same WhatsApp account that scanned the QR code
ALLOW_FROM_ME=true

# Set to true when using a dedicated bot number so any @mention of the bot triggers it
TRIGGER_ON_MENTION=false

# Optional: Phone number (digits only with country code, e.g. 919876543210) to use a 8-digit Pairing Code instead of QR Code
PAIRING_PHONE_NUMBER=

# Maximum execution time per task in milliseconds (default: 10 minutes)
TASK_TIMEOUT_MS=600000

# Optional: Email (SMTP) configuration for drafting & sending emails with attachments
SMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com
SMTP_PORT=465
SMTP_USER=
SMTP_PASS=

# Optional: Groq API Key for instant Whisper voice note transcription (falls back to built-in speech recognition)
GROQ_API_KEY=

# Owner email address for "mail this to me" and Google Calendar events
OWNER_EMAIL=your-email@example.com

# Optional: Google OAuth 2.0 (PKCE) for direct Gemini API, Google Calendar & Gmail
# Create credentials at: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=
GOOGLE_REDIRECT_PORT=8085

# Optional: Direct Gemini API (standalone alternative without requiring local agy CLI)
# Get your key at: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey
GEMINI_API_KEY=
GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-2.5-flash
